decision.placement_claim: The shared claim-evidence capability probably owns impact, refresh, reliance, and obligation record semantics; domain workflows own semantic judgments and reopening decisions; a general control-plane capability may own cross-owner delivery without acquiring claim meaning; evidence-anchor observers resolve declared claim anchors against one exact observed snapshot and derive nomination candidates; and Codebase Memory is the probable code-observation backend and non-authoritative discovery source, hosting no claim-system records, with production use waiting on coherent, content-verified snapshot observation through a supported interface.
decision.rationale: Shadow correspondence experiments against Codebase Memory ec4fbd3a (evidence/codebase-memory-correspondence-20261010.md) indicate that correspondence between claims and changing code needs no externally writable graph projection: declared anchors are evidence anchors owned by the declaring claim revision and are observed by the evidence-anchor substrate, while Codebase Memory supplies structural observation and discovery only. The bounded sync_projection extension the prior decision placed is therefore withdrawn from this proposal's placement. Architectural feasibility of the observation placement is supported; provider readiness is not, because the tested revision cannot attribute an observation to one coherent, content-verified snapshot through its supported interface (frozen exposed generation across incremental re-indexes, snippets that apply indexed line ranges to current disk bytes, mtime-and-size freshness). Placement stays probable. The revised narrative (proposal.md, placement.md, repository-integration.md) and acceptance.md's structural cases, remapped from projection to observation without lowering the acceptance bar and with the relationship-anchor verification gap recorded, are approved with this decision. Ownership of claim meaning, the approved proposal meaning, and the retained end-to-end and adversarial evidence bar are unchanged. Dependent proposal concern-scoped-review-judgments relied on sync_projection and is flagged in repository-integration.md for its own review; its documents are not changed by this decision.
reopening_conditions: The production foundation cannot preserve the stable identities, revisions, profiles, and authority envelopes required by this phase.
Concurrent or branching refresh requires a different canonical-support model than explicit attributed selection among immutable revisions.
A real domain consumer cannot distinguish candidate impact, investigation, unchanged refresh, changed support, applicability, and reopening without collapsing owners.
The slice lifecycle cannot durably preserve or derive the exact attributed checkpoint subject needed for post-slice impact analysis before its terminal projection becomes lossy.

Stable code, test, schema, configuration, or documentation-anchor identity cannot be reconciled across rename, move, split, merge, deletion, and ambiguity without converting uncertain structural matching into semantic authority.
Codebase Memory, or another observation backend, cannot provide coherent, content-verified snapshot observation and explicit unresolved anchor state through a supported interface.

A consumer establishes a product consequence that on-demand correspondence, derived from canonical records and snapshot-bound observations, cannot preserve, or independent consumers establish a separate product consequence for a generic projection-synchronization capability.
Cross-owner obligation delivery cannot be made lossless and idempotent without assigning semantic completion to transport acknowledgement.
Compaction, authority revocation, inactive recipients, or partial publication requires durable semantics outside the proposed claim, domain-workflow, and delivery ownership split.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner
authority.evidence: Explicit user instruction on 2026-10-10 ('Let's continue with 1') to record approval of the claim-maintenance placement revision and revised acceptance criteria through the revise_placement transition, after an independent ChatGPT review judged the placement and acceptance revision ready for approval and approved the decision mechanism (committed 303c804) without implying implementation authority.
